task: Mitigate Tempo OOMKilled (#420) by disabling the 1GiB Go ballast and setting GOMEMLIMIT; the cause is an unproven hypothesis, and live effect, image Go version and persistence are out of scope

events.summary: Only tempo.memBallastSizeMbs and tempo.extraEnv (GOMEMLIMIT) are added to the Tempo Application values; the memory limit, requests, persistence and image tag stay as they were.

Issue #420 reports tempo-0 last terminated OOMKilled during compactor block merge with args -mem-ballast-size-mbs=1024 and a 1536Mi limit (steady state ~827Mi). Taken from the issue; not reproduced or re-observed in this session.
evidence: doc:issue #420 (kubectl describe pod tempo-0, as reported by the requester)

events.summary: tempo.memBallastSizeMbs: 0 and GOMEMLIMIT=1280MiB (below the 1536Mi limit) on the chart tempo 2.2.3 values. Root cause is a hypothesis (ballast raises the GC heap target above the cgroup limit), not confirmed; the 256Mi headroom is a starting value.

events.scope: chart key wiring, static regression suite and manifest validation
events.summary: helm template of chart tempo 2.2.3 with the Application valuesObject renders -mem-ballast-size-mbs=0 and env GOMEMLIMIT=1280MiB on the tempo container. Not verified: restart count after rollout, the Go version of the tempo 2.9.0 image, behavior of ballast 0 in 2.9.0.

Claim limited to the static GitOps values: the Tempo Application now renders ballast 0 and GOMEMLIMIT=1280MiB. It does not claim the OOMKills stop; the restart on rollout loses un-flushed WAL and local blocks because persistence is off.
Complete and verified within the stated static scope; NOT verified: effect on OOMKills, restart count after rollout (watch tempo-0 for a few days), the Go version of the tempo 2.9.0 image
